To continue building **muvi**, we need two backend services that handle data and file storage. Here's what they do and where you can sign up for them for free:

### 1. Supabase (Database, Auth & Realtime Chat)
**What it is:** Supabase is an open-source alternative to Firebase. It gives us a PostgreSQL database, a user authentication system, and real-time WebSockets right out of the box. 
**Why we need it:** We will use Supabase to store all the movie metadata (titles, TMDB IDs, who uploaded it), manage user accounts and collections, and power the real-time chat rooms you requested in your SRS.
**Where to sign up:**
1. Go to [supabase.com](https://supabase.com/) and sign up for a free account.
2. Create a new Project.
3. Once the project is created, navigate to **Project Settings -> API** to find your `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL` and `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY`.

### 2. Cloudflare R2 (Video File Storage)
**What it is:** Cloudflare R2 is an S3-compatible cloud object storage service, meaning it works exactly like Amazon S3 but with **zero data egress (download) fees**.
**Why we need it:** Storing and streaming video files takes a massive amount of bandwidth. Traditional providers charge you every time a user streams a video. R2 allows us to store the heavy video files and stream them to your app directly via HTTP Range requests without paying for download bandwidth.
**Where to sign up:**
1. Go to [cloudflare.com](https://www.cloudflare.com/) and sign up.
2. In the dashboard, look for **R2 Object Storage** in the sidebar. You will need to enable it (it has a generous free tier of 10GB storage/month).
3. Click **Create Bucket** and name it something like `muvi-storage`.
4. To get your keys, go to the R2 overview page and click **Manage R2 API Tokens** -> **Create API token** (Give it "Object Read & Write" permissions).
5. This will generate your `R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID`, `R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY`, and `R2_ACCOUNT_ID`.

Once you've signed up and grabbed those keys, just create a new file named `.env.local` in the root of your `c:\Users\ASUS\muvi` folder and paste them in like this:

NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL=your_supabase_url
NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=your_supabase_anon_key
